name: claudeos
description: Free, MIT-licensed skills from ClaudeOS: a read-only code review, deep web research with labelled evidence, and a research digest.

plugins.name: claudeos-skills
plugins.description: Three standalone skills: claudeos-qa-review (read-only code review), claudeos-deep-research (web research with CONFIRMED / INFERRED / UNVERIFIED labels) and claudeos-research-digest (research, then a one-page summary). They need nothing else from ClaudeOS.
